messages:
kevin: Quick thought — when someone views Route details we should surface a compact RBAC breadcrumb in the header: Role → Scope → Binding. Minimal by default, expandable to see the derivation path.

maria: +1. Right now folks have to jump into Role editor which is confusing and interrupts flow.

sara: Can we show the computed effective grants inline? e.g. 'Effective: invoke, read-embeddings' — short list.

tim: Security question: could this UI leak tenant membership or group names? we need to be explicit on what we expose.

design-ara: Mocked a compact chip layout: [Role: Billing-admin] > [Scope: tenant:acme/*] > [Derived via: group=ops-team]. Hover on 'Derived via' shows the binding path, otherwise hide members.

security-bot: audit: UI permission-inspection is recorded. Make sure views are logged. :lock:

kevin: Implementation idea: add internal API GET /internal/permissions/effective?principal=<>&resource=<> which returns a small payload. Example response: 
```json
{
  "principal": "service-account:billing-svc",
  "effective": ["invoke:model.call", "embed:read"],
  "sources": [
    {"type":"role_binding","id":"rb-123","role":"BillingAdmin","scope":"tenant:acme/*"}
  ]
}
```

maria: We'll cache the response for ~60s and expose telemetry for perm_lookup.success and perm_lookup.cache_hit.

tim: Delegated admins: they should see that a binding exists but shouldn’t be able to expand to view members unless they have explicit audit scope.

kevin: Proposed UI rule: crumb visible if user has VIEW_PERMISSIONS. Expand action gated by VIEW_PERMISSIONS + (AUDIT_SCOPE OR owner). Microcopy: 'Shows how access is derived; does not expose member identities.'

design-ara: UX note: long binding chains should collapse with '... +3 more' and be expandable. Avoid pushing horizontal overflow.

maria: Canary plan: feature flag 'rbac_breadcrumbs_v1', enable for 10% orgs and internal teams first.

tim: I'll create a rollout flag in releases and wire to console. No objections to 10%?

design-ara: No objections.

sara: Tests: unit for API shape, integration for console rendering, and e2e for permission gating. Also add an audit event PERM_VIEWED.

kevin: Telemetry fields to emit on expand: {event: 'perm_expand', org_id, viewer_role, principal_type, expansion_depth}. Also record cache_hit boolean.

security-bot: Flagged: scrub PII in logs; mask usernames and tenant ids where required. Ensure cache keys are encrypted at rest. :warning:

kevin: Dev note: call into existing route-affinity cache to avoid N^2 lookups when computing effective grants for many principals. Also add rate limit on API: 1000 reqs/s/org default.

maria: I'll open a PR with the API + UI scaffold, assign @kevin and @tim for review.

kevin: Will prototype CSS and sample payloads tomorrow. :eyes:

tim: I'll wire the canary and create the release toggle.

sara: LGTM from infra/testing side.

maria: Follow-ups: PR, add telemetry dashboard (perm lookup latency + error rate), and a small acceptance checklist for delegated admin behavior.

kevin: Ok, thanks all. We'll keep the initial rollout conservative and iterate on microcopy + telemetry.
